Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate current preview source, updater transaction tests, and offline signing helper syntax
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source branch: main
Scope: Windows x64 restore, self-contained publish, exact two-file package validation, updater success/rollback tests, and PowerShell parser check of the offline key helper.
Security: parser check does not execute the helper or generate a key. The runner does not upload private source, app packages, build artifacts, signing keys, or credentials.
